name: Outreach Console
description: Operator console for the MIT outreach engine: what goes out next, approvals, review, manual tasks and kill switches. The engine runs outside Papr's databases (ADR 0004).

requirements.name: OUTREACH_API_URL
requirements.description: Loopback URL of `outreach serve`, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787

requirements.name: OUTREACH_API_TOKEN
requirements.description: Token from `outreach token create <principal> --role approver` (viewer for read-only).

app.name: Outreach Console
app.description: What leaves the building next, and the one control that stops it.

deploymentProfiles.name: Desktop pilot
deploymentProfiles.notes: Desktop-only pilot. Keep publishing disabled. Configure absolute OUTREACH_CLI_ENTRY and OUTREACH_DB in the job environment; verify the job executes locally before enabling its schedule.
